goal: Three distinct content pieces per app per PHT day for seven days, not identical clones on every channel.
activation: READ_ONLY_CONTROL_CENTER; existing platform writers preserved, no automatic 42-piece publication

facebook.gate: Before 3/day upgrade, reconcile existing Facebook queue and prove 42 creative final assets, claims and capacity.

pinterest.gate: Board selectable in Buffer browser but API board ID and root-only printed artwork must pass; avoid PIREVO Finds.

tiktok.gate: Actual unique 30fps media, rights/voice/subtitles, AI label, queue and duplicate reconciliation.

youtube.gate: Owner access to Studio and actual public scheduled Shorts proof. API uploader unverified projects may publish private only.
youtube.account_owner_action: resolve Studio access; schedule first original video natively

instagram.gate: Owner creates/authorizes genuine brand account, links Facebook Page; native scheduling verified before claiming automation.
instagram.account_owner_action: create and secure authentic AstraLabs Instagram business/creator profile if wanted

reddit.gate: Check each community current rules, truthful founder disclosure, no spam/bulk comment bots, owner Reddit identity/approval.
reddit.account_owner_action: identify existing Reddit account or create an authentic one and authorize posting

linkedin.gate: Verify owner Page authority, post practical maritime learning content, no mass solicitation.

secrets_policy: Never store API keys, tokens, passwords, cookies, or personal data in this public repository. Connected provider credentials must remain in scoped GitHub Actions secrets or approved confidential service vault.
writer_policy: One active publishing writer per channel. Any second authorized Buffer account requires separate secrets, explicitly approved channel ownership and distinct channel mapping; never connect the same social account to two Buffer organizations.
media_policy: Do not mark PLANNED creative as APPROVED or PUBLISHED without exact licensed media asset and proof of actual platform result.
financial_policy: PHP0 incremental spend; no recurring paid services without owner approval and evidence of expected payoff.
reporting_policy: A successful control-center check is NOT proof that any channel posted. Native permalink is required for LIVE.
